pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are primarily polygonal with moderate edge angularity. Spatial area of patches is greatest on the mid-neck, decreasing in size towards the lower shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected pathways of light pelage exhibiting high continuity. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent. Pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform, approximately 1/8th the width of adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane along the upper neck presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged profile against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Dark-pigmented tail tuft visible on the posterior aspect of the subject.
